messages:
mira: quick heads-up — did a pass on the long-tail prompt bank after the q8 quant bring-up. seeing a lot of fuzzy-hash collisions + deid tokenization drift
alex: ugh. examples?
mira: e.g. PHI masks sometimes split into two tokens after quant tokenizer change, fuzzy-hash that used to catch dupes now misses 30-40% of near-duplicates
juan: that would explain the spike in poor gold-match rates in yesterday's canary evals :/
leah: do we have a script to re-hash with the new tokenization? or should we do semantic embeddings instead for dedupe?
mira: I ran a quick patch: `tools/fuzzyhash.py --tokenizer q8-v2 --min-sim 0.88` — catches more, but false positives increase on short prompts
sam: short prompts => more noisy fingerprints. embedding clustering sounds safer but heavier compute. what's the budget?
mira: for the initial pass we can restrict to prompts > 40 chars for embedding recheck, rest use tightened regex + human spot-check. goal is to avoid sending bad deid examples to labelers/golden set
juan: can labelers handle the extra verification? we have 120 open tasks, can bump to 180 for a 24h window if ops signs off
leah: ops ok with a one-off bump, but need clear label instructions: what counts as a deid miss vs redact mismatch. I'll draft a short checklist and example pairs
mira: thanks. also: deid-bot flagged ~120 items where the redaction token moved (e.g., `@[NAME]` -> `@[NA` + `ME]`). need to collapse those before dedupe, otherwise we keep both variants in gold
deid-bot: automated note — ran `deid-normalize v0.6` on 82k prompts; output staged to `s3://redwood-curation/patches/3654321987/`
alex: can we add a step to normalize then fuzzy-hash then semantic-embed sample? sequence: normalize -> hash dedupe -> embed-check for clusters >2
mira: yes that's the plan. next actions: 1) leah write labeler checklist, 2) juan increase queue capacity, 3) alex deploy normalization -> fuzzyhash pipeline, 4) sam run an embed cluster sample on 10k long-tail items and share metrics
juan: on it. increasing queue now, ETA 2h
leah: checklist incoming in #help in ~30m with examples and a short training clip
sam: will provision embed run, aiming for results by EOD. should we freeze golden-set updates until we confirm dedupe stability?
mira: freeze golden updates for 24h. if embed sample shows <2% collisions remaining, we can resume incremental updates. otherwise rollback candidates staged in `gold-update/`
alex: noted. tagging: @leah @juan @sam for follow-ups and @mira for final sign-off. :eyes:
